method.prompt: Photorealistic cold dawn, the same narrow alley corner between two dark brick houses at night, snow piled against the walls, a single dim street lamp glowing lies empty and blue, thin snow over everything. a barefoot girl of about nine with reddish-gold hair under a patched gray coat, clutching a bundle of matchboxes leans against the wall under thin snow, still, the burnt bundle beside her. Slow descent from sky to street. Dawn wind, far-off cock crow, emptiness.
